set.summary: The owner and the orchestrator (Claude Code in Rex) planned milestone 2 inside Genesis on 2026-10-25, right after milestone 1's import. Decided: milestone 2 is "Genesis runs the work" (layers 3–4), so milestone 3 is built with Genesis orchestrating; milestone 2 is an intent its change sets serve, with done points as child intents verified by Evidence; depends-on means only "can't start before", so the area chain is retired and the areas become a backlog; milestone work is carved out of the area bundles; a write sees the change sets it depends on, change sets land in dependency order, dropped dependencies and cycles are reported, rebasing stays manual; the scope (Claude Code adapter, runs with a built-in ship-change workflow, messages to a running step, interview answers as Decisions, blocked runs that tell the owner) and what is out; shipit stays the agent step; eight change sets, with 1, 2 and 7 written in full first and 3, 4, 5 and 8 proposed with intent only; the owner gave the go-ahead to accept 1, 2 and 7. Every answer was the owner accepting the orchestrator's proposal; the proposals' wording is the orchestrator's. Later: carving as decided couldn't be done with today's Genesis (re-creating a bundle's node changes its ID), so the owner added change set 9, carving that keeps IDs: carve by node, two entries with the same node and link IDs, the source made to depend on the target, its rules, and 3, 4, 5 and 8 depending on it.

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, after carving was found not to work as decided
fields.statement: A new milestone-2 change set, carving that keeps IDs, comes before the leaves of change sets 3, 4, 5 and 8, because re-creating a bundle's node in another change set changes its ID and breaks the bundle.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 6: carving that keeps IDs
fields.statement: genesis carve <node>... --from <change set> --to <change set> moves each named node's create, every op in the source that writes it, and every link in the source that starts or ends at it; children move only with --with-children.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 6: carving that keeps IDs
fields.statement: A carve writes one revision entry in the source dropping the moved ops and one ops entry in the target re-creating them with the same node and link IDs and new op IDs, both stamped with the actor and referring to each other.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 6: carving that keeps IDs
fields.statement: When the source still has ops resting on a moved node, carve adds source depends-on target; a carve that would close a cycle is refused.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 6: carving that keeps IDs
fields.statement: Both change sets are unlanded, the target isn't terminal, and every moved op still applies in the target's view; an emptied source gets next: genesis withdraw, but carve doesn't withdraw it. carve has --dry-run, --json, a describe schema and api call carve.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, topic 6: carving that keeps IDs
fields.statement: Carving is milestone-2 change set 9, under change-sets, serving milestone-2; change sets 3, 4, 5 and 8 depend on it, and it writes their leaves as its first use.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner
